findings.headline: referral leads recorded acquisition won amount in the available CRM history
findings.summary: Channel rankings describe recorded CRM outcomes. They do not estimate incremental channel value.
caveats: Recorded amounts have material zero-value coverage.

findings.headline: Creative metadata supports bundle-level hypotheses only
findings.summary: The strongest labeled bundle is Blog / Problem / FOMO at 0.1%, but only five ads contain complete format/message/tone labels.
caveats: Format, message, tone, and CTA are confounded.

findings.headline: Touchpoint evidence is bounded by 2024 marketing-log coverage
findings.summary: 682 opportunities link to eligible 365-day touches. The percentage is not a measure of full-history tracking completeness.

findings.headline: 2,032 explicit ICP target domains remain eligible for a controlled coverage test
findings.summary: The audience excludes current customers, active opportunities, non-target accounts, and conflicting profiles.
caveats: Current fit is an association, not historical causal evidence.

recommendations.decision: Maintain and measure the strongest observed acquisition channels
evidence_limitations: Observed outcomes are not causal channel effects.
recommendations.immediate_next_step: Review the scorecard by 2023 and 2024 before expanding spend.
recommendations.primary_success_measure: Resolved win rate and recorded pipeline in a comparable scope
recommendations.scale_stop_rule: Do not reallocate budget from historical ratios alone.

recommendations.content_or_creative_bundle: Create matched variants that isolate format, message, and tone
evidence_limitations: Existing labeled ads confound multiple creative dimensions.
recommendations.immediate_next_step: Run controlled variants with the same audience and delivery window.
recommendations.primary_success_measure: Platform-specific CTR and downstream account engagement
recommendations.scale_stop_rule: Keep claims exploratory until variants isolate one dimension.

evidence_limitations: Observed reached-account rates may reflect selection and seller activity.
recommendations.primary_success_measure: New CRM opportunity creation within 90 days
recommendations.scale_stop_rule: Scale only after a feasible scenario shows incremental qualified opportunities.

recommendations.decision: Report source and journey evidence separately
evidence_limitations: Attribution does not estimate incremental lift.
recommendations.immediate_next_step: Publish overlap, coverage, and model/window sensitivity together.
recommendations.primary_success_measure: Complete attribution report with explicit population coverage
recommendations.scale_stop_rule: Do not use linked influence as a universal revenue total.
